name: Bodyweight Side-Lying Biceps Curl
steps: Lie on your side with your legs stacked, your lower elbow planted and your lower hand cradling the side of your head.
Rest your top hand on your thigh and bend your lower elbow to lift your head and upper torso together.
Ease your torso back down while keeping your elbow planted.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your neck aligned cleanly with your torso as your bottom arm curls you upward.
Avoid pushing off the floor with your top hand so your bottom biceps does the work.
